verdict.rationale: ByteAsk has no dedicated bulk or batch feature. Its headless `byteask exec` mode (one task to completion, JSON Lines output, schema-conformant results) is built for scripting and CI, so a user could loop over many items with external scripts. A single agent task can also edit multiple files across a codebase. Missing for 10: a native bulk/batch operation over many items at once, documentation of parallel or multi-target runs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
